content: When establishing glycemic targets for patients, healthcare providers must take into account several individualized factors. These include the duration of the patient’s diabetes, their overall life expectancy, the presence and severity of any significant complications, and the patient’s level of motivation and ability to adhere to treatment plans. For patients who are at an elevated risk of cardiovascular or renal complications, the use of specific medications such as sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 (SGLT2) inhibitors or glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists may provide additional therapeutic benefits. These medications have been shown to improve outcomes in individuals with these high-risk profiles.
